chorister.name: 0-1 Chorister
chorister.description: Choristers sacrifice themselves upon black altars, and if worthy, rise after nine days, finishing their own beheading as their severed heads begin to sing.
chorister.battlekit: A Chorister can have any Battlekit from the Heretic Legions Armoury Tables.
chorister.abilities: **Unholy Hymns:** Add -1 DICE to Success Rolls taken for enemy models that are within 8" of one or more Choristers.
